In [68]:
train["hour"] = (
    train["timestamp"]
    .str.split(":")
    .str[0]
    .astype(int)
)

train["minute"] = (
    train["timestamp"]
    .str.split(":")
    .str[1]
    .astype(int)
)

train["minute_of_day"] = (
    train["hour"]*60
    + train["minute"]
)

  1. Feature Signal Analysis
In [93]:
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

eda_df = train.copy()

for col in eda_df.select_dtypes(include="object").columns:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    eda_df[col] = le.fit_transform(
        eda_df[col].astype(str)
    )
In [94]:
# Fill missing values

for col in eda_df.columns:
    
    if col == "demand":
        continue

    if eda_df[col].dtype in ["float64", "float32", "int64", "int32"]:
        eda_df[col] = eda_df[col].fillna(
            eda_df[col].median()
        )
    else:
        eda_df[col] = eda_df[col].fillna(
            eda_df[col].mode()[0]
        )

X = eda_df.drop(
    columns=["demand", "temp_bin"],
    errors="ignore"
)

y = eda_df["demand"]

mi = mutual_info_regression(
    X,
    y,
    random_state=42
)
